intro.text: An older innkeeper on Diggen's Point who helps Brick brew at weekends and plays darts with Lem.

items.text: Lem, the better darts player, once got Rod home after a night of heavy drinking. Rod was one of those Lem silently asked for help getting Tress onto the Oot's Dream. He probably helped pass the word around, though he wasn't there when she got aboard.
